item.description: The police response to the murder of Henry Nowak has triggered a heated transatlantic debate.

item.description: In Virunga National Park, rangers are on the frontlines — playing a critical role to contain the surging virus while coping with an upsurge in conflict-related violence.

item.title: Israeli airstrikes kill 9 including Lebanese army officers after ceasefire deal
item.description: The Israeli military confirmed hitting a vehicle and said the incident is being reviewed. Lebanon's President Joseph Aoun called the strike "a flagrant violation to Lebanese sovereignty and international law."

item.title: In Ohio, the Sikh community passes traditions to the next generation
item.description: Photographer Akash Pamarthy has documented the Sikh religious community in Ohio over several years. His photos tell a story.

item.title: The Forest Service says it's closing offices to cut costs. But the math doesn't add up
item.description: The Forest Service is trying to shut down research hubs because it says it needs to live within its means. But the agency plans to close facilities that cost less than $1 to rent while keeping open one that costs $1 million.

item.title: Man dies after bitten by shark in Western Australia, police say
item.description: The man was spearfishing off Michaelmas Island with his family, according to local reports.

item.description: The Welsh singer has announced her first concert after a sexual assault led her to step away from public life.
